rules: Routes between the main Polish airports and their partner airports with passengers in the newest 12 months Eurostat publishes.
Passengers are those carried on the route in both directions in each month.
Routes to airports beyond the map end at the map edge, in the true direction of the destination.
Each domestic route is reported by both of its airports and is listed from each end.

attribution.processed: We selected the 12 latest months, matched airports to OurAirports positions and drew routes as arcs.
attribution.disclaimer: Eurostat is not responsible for the changes.
